verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a broad REST API covering creating, listing and resuming agent runs, retrieving logs and traces, banning checks, editing PR state, generating setup commands, analyzing sandbox logs and reading org integrations. A Python SDK wraps it with 'all the same capabilities,' and a CLI exists. However, nothing claims full UI parity, and several UI-configured surfaces have no API counterpart in the evidence: agent behavior/permission settings, installing integrations (GitHub App, Slack, Linear) and MCP server provisioning. The integrations endpoint is shown only as a read-only overview, and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable at standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API endpoints for settings and permissions management, API-driven integration setup, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
